summary: Skip recognized controlled Codex update menus without upgrading the provider

replay.detail: No replay or claim projection change.

compatibility.detail: Controlled Codex update menus with an explicit Escape-to-Skip footer are skipped once per prompt episode; authentication and other terminal prompts retain their existing handling. No client or peer wire change.

downtime.detail: No service restart or provider upgrade required by this change.

manual.detail: Codex upgrades remain an Operations action. Unrecognized menus and unsuccessful automatic skips retain the existing attention path.

recovery.detail: Existing update-prompt and restored diagnostics retain episode history; an attempted key never proves readiness.
